strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% mahala
strings.seo.why[0].text: Gũtirĩ mbia cia mweri, gũtirĩ karata ya kĩbega, gũtirĩ ruo rwa ithano rũthondekagwo dosi-inĩ ciaku.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Gũtirĩ kwandĩkithia
strings.seo.why[1].text: Gũtirĩ akaunti ya kũthondeka: hingura ithandiko, teithia dosi ciaku, kĩrĩkia.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Dosi ciaku ciarĩ cia kũ
strings.seo.why[2].text: Nĩ ciathondetwo, thutha ciagwo mara imwe. Tũtigatigaga dosi ciaku kana ũhoro waku.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Mĩthemba yothe
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, mbica, EPUB… kuuma komputa kana simu.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Nĩ ma mbui atĩ pdff nĩ mahala?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ii. Kĩndũ gĩothe nĩ mahala, gũtirĩ ruo rwa ithano na gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩhingĩte na mbia cia mweri. Gũtirĩ karata ya kĩbega ĩendwo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Aca. Gũtirĩ kwandĩkithia, gũtirĩ anuuni ya thirĩ: ũhoka indo cianyu mara imwe.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Aca. Dosi ciaku irutithagio wĩra tu wĩra ũrio ũrendwo, thutha ciagwo. Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũsocogaga na gũtirĩ rĩrĩa ciheanagwo.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ii. pdff ĩrutithagia wĩra kibirũzi-inĩ ya simu yothe, tabireti kana komputa (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), gũtirĩ kĩndũ gĩa kũkia.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, mbica (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML na ingĩ.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ũngĩthondeka nginya dosi {files} gĩkundi kĩmwe, na dosi ĩthondeketwo ĩkoragwo na macunjĩ nginya {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ũgitĩri
strings.privacy.description: Atĩa pdff irutithagia dosi ciaku: gũtirĩ akaunti, gũtirĩ dosi ĩgwo, gũtirĩ matangazo na gũtirĩ gũtunda ũhoro.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff nĩ yombirwo nĩguo dosi ciaku ciarĩ cia kũ. Haha nĩ mandiko ma hinya, kĩrĩa gĩkĩhĩtia rĩrĩa wĩra ũrutithagio.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosi ciaku
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Nĩ citumagwo ciarĩgitĩritwo (HTTPS), igĩthondekwo kwa wĩra, thutha ciagwo mara imwe kĩrĩa kĩthondeketwo kĩtegithĩte. Dosi nene cirotithagio hakuhi na rĩĩtwa rĩa kĩha na nĩ cigatagirwo wĩra ũrio ũrĩkia; kũtheria kwa wĩra nĩ kũthara kĩndũ gĩothe gĩtiga thĩinĩ wa thaa 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Gũtirĩ akaunti, gũtirĩ ũhoro waku
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ndĩendaga kwandĩkithia, gũtirĩ anuuni ya thirĩ na gũtirĩ karata ya kĩbega. Dosi ciaku ndĩthomeragwo, ndĩthereragwo, ndĩgayanagwo kana nĩ ciumagwo kũrutithia arũme a ũũgĩ.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kũringwo kwanja
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tũringaga matandiko tũtarĩ na marĩĩtwa na gũtirĩ kũgira cookies (Vercel Web Analytics) nĩguo twĩmanyĩre indo iria irutithagia wĩra. Gũtirĩ matangazo, gũtirĩ gũteng'eria mĩthia.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie ĩmwe ya kũhitia: ĩriragĩria rũrimi rĩa wũrĩirie.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kũrirwo
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Ithandiko nĩ rĩriragwo nĩ Vercel seva-inĩ cia Paris; Word, Excel na PowerPoint nĩ ciarutithagio wĩra nĩ Render seva-inĩ cia Frankfurt. Aheani aya marutithagia dosi wĩra tu wa kahinda ka gũgarura.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Twĩteithie
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ũria kana macokio? Twĩkinyĩre kuuma ithandiko-inĩ rĩa wĩra:
